title: A must see in Seville
text: Sara gave us an excellent tour full of interesting information.  She was engaging, funny and knowledgeable.  The pace and group size were both excellent.  My only criticism is that the tour operator should have reminded us about the need to bring ID to get in (fortunately we had some anyway) and the ‘dress code’ for the cathedral.
author: Claire_W

title: Amazing tour
text: Guadalupe our tour guide was informative and delightful.  She was so knowledgeable and fun. Her love for the city and history shines through.  It was so amazing to know all the history and backstory’s so we could really appreciate the historical significance.  Perfecto!!
author: tamaraw367

title: We loved it
text: 100% recommended . If, in addition, you are lucky enough to have Eduardo as your guide, you will not regret it...he tells you about the history of each place in great detail and with his anecdotes, he makes the visit enjoyable .
author: F2897KOcarolinap

title: Passionate Guide
text: Very knowledgeable and passionate guide. She explained in detail the history and background of the cathedral and tower as well as the Alcázar.
author: Jessie_H

title: Seville tour
text: An experience I absolutely recommend. Compliments to our guide, Maria, clear, professional, and engaging.
author: albertobZ9069CY

title: Excellent Tour of Seville’s Highlights
text:
We really enjoyed the Crown Tours Priority Access Cathedral, Giralda & Alcázar Tour.

Our guide, Maria V, was excellent — friendly, knowledgeable and engaging throughout the tour. She provided plenty of interesting information about the history and significance of the Cathedral, Giralda and Alcázar and was always happy to answer questions.

Maria’s relaxed and friendly approach made the tour informative without feeling overwhelming and made the whole experience very pleasant.

The priority access was also a great advantage and allowed us to make the most of our time exploring these incredible
author: stacoaus

title: Great tour - defintely recommend
text: This was a great trip. Great guide who spoke good English and was very funny. Lots of information, and beautiful sights. Absolutely recommend. Also gets you into places quicker.
